After reviewing the scoring record, the official scorer confirmed that Tyler Grant made 39 in the first innings, replacing the provisional figure of 40.
The same notice credited Noah Reed with three wickets rather than the five shown on the live card.
It also fixed the first-innings extras at 19, superseding the provisional total of 22.
A fan mirror saved before the scorer's review still shows Tyler Grant on 40, gives Noah Reed five wickets and lists 22 extras for the first innings. The mirror does not carry the official correction.
